# Tubi

> Tubi is a free ad-supported streaming platform offering 40,000+ movies, TV shows, live channels, and original content without subscription requirements.

Tubi provides unlimited access to a diverse entertainment catalog spanning comedy, action, drama, sci-fi, horror, and reality content across web, iOS, Android, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices. The platform is operated by Fox Ad Solutions and headquartered in San Francisco.

## Key Topics

- Free streaming
- Ad-supported platform
- Movies and TV shows
- Live TV channels
- Comedy films
- Action thrillers
- Crime dramas
- Original content
- Multi-device support
- No subscription required
- Content catalog
- Entertainment platform
- Streaming service
- Watch online
- Family entertainment

## Core Streaming Services

- [Watch Free Movies and TV Shows Online](https://tubitv.com): Tubi homepage featuring free streaming movies and TV shows across multiple genres
- [Watch Free Movies Online](https://tubitv.com/movies): Browse Tubi's catalog of 40,000+ free movies across Action, Horror, Sci-Fi, Comedy
- [Watch Free TV Shows Online](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows): Browse Tubi's 40,000+ free TV shows including comedy, drama, cartoons, reality
- [Watch Free Live TV, Movies and TV Shows Online](https://tubitv.com/live): Stream free live TV channels with news, sports, weather, and entertainment
